title: Forest River, Inc.: Entry Door Latch Failure (19 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2013 Coachmen Cross Country and 2023 Coachmen Sportscoach Motorhomes.  The entry door latch may fail and not allow entry or exit.

title: Airstream, Inc.: Gas Valves May Fracture Causing Gas Leak (6,827 affected)
summary: Airstream Inc. (Airstream) is recalling certain 2021-2023 Basecamp, Bambi, Atlas, and Interstate travel trailers, equipped with certain SDS2 2-Burner Drop-in Cooktops.  The internal aluminum burner tubes that connect to the gas valves may fracture and cause a gas leak.

title: Mazda North American Operations: Trailer Hitch Harness May Detach (560 affected)
summary: Mazda North America Operations (Mazda) is recalling certain 2023 CX-50 vehicles equipped with a Mazda Genuine Accessory trailer hitch.  The trailer hitch harness may detach and become damaged, which can result in inoperative trailer lights and/or brakes.

title: Ferrari North America, Inc.: Passenger Air Bag May Impact Child Seat/FMVSS 208 (13 affected)
summary: Ferrari is recalling certain 2021-2023 Ferrari SF90 Coupe and 2022 SF90 Spider hybrid electric vehicles.  When a child seat is installed on the passenger seat (size M), the deployment of the air bag may impact the child seat.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 208, "Occupant Crash Protection."

title: Continental Tire the Americas, LLC: Incorrect Tire Identification Number/FMVSS 574 (3 affected)
summary: Continental Tire the Americas, LLC (Continental Tire) is recalling certain General Altimax RT43, size 175/65R14 82T tires. The tires contain a tire identification number (TIN) that is missing the 3-digit plant code and the 6-symbol manufacturer's identification mark.  As such, these tires fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 574, "Tire Identification & Recordkeeping."

title: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC: Third-Row Child Seat May Have Reduced Strength (812 affected)
summary: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC (Land Rover) is recalling certain 2023 Land Rover Defender 130 vehicles equipped with third-row seats.  The third-row seatback latch may not latch properly, reducing the strength of a child seat installed to the top tether.

title: Newmar Corporation: Entry Door Latch Failure (151 affected)
summary: Newmar Corporation (Newmar) is recalling certain 2021-2023 Bay Star, 2023 Bay Star Sport and Canyon Star motorhomes.  The entry door latch may fail and not allow entry or exit.

title: Off Grid Trailers: Cooktop Gas Valves May Fracture Causing Gas Leak (150 affected)
summary: Off Grid Trailers (Off Grid) is recalling certain 2020-2022 Pando, 2020-2023 Expedition, and Switchback travel trailers, equipped with certain SDS2 2-Burner Drop-in Cooktops.  The internal aluminum burner tubes that connect to the gas valves may fracture and cause a gas leak.

title: Winnebago Industries, Inc.: Missing Rear Reflectors/FMVSS 108 (22 affected)
summary: Winnebago Industries, Inc. (Winnebago) is recalling certain 2023 Adventurer, Vista and Itasca Sunstar motorhomes.  The motorhomes may be missing the rear reflectors.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: Harbor Freight Tools: Motorcycle Lift Failure (41,715 affected)
summary: Harbor Freight Tools (Harbor Freight) is recalling certain Central Hydraulics High Position Motorcycle Lifts with part number 99887.  The lift welds or tubing may break, which can allow the lift to fall or drop the motorcycle.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Missing Supports for Fresh Water Tank (272 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2020-2023 Palomino Solaire 320TSBH travel trailers.  These vehicles may be missing the rearward and forward supports for the freshwater tank, which may cause the tank to become dislodged.

title: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing: Tonneau Cover May Detach (130,266 affected)
summary: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2022-2023 Tundra and Tundra Hybrid vehicles that may be equipped with a Toyota genuine accessory tonneau cover.  The tonneau cover attachment joints may come loose and allow the cover to detach.

title: Dorel Juvenile Group: Child Seat Lower Anchor Failure/FMVSS 213 (59,457 affected)
summary: Dorel Juvenile Group (Dorel) is recalling certain Safety 1st onBoard 35 Secure Tech, Safety 1st Secure Tech Infant Base, Maxi-Cosi Coral XP, Maxi-Cosi Mico XP Max, Maxi-Cosi Mico XP, Maxi-Cosi Mico Luxe+, and Maxi-Cosi Infant Base child seats.  Please refer to Dorel's recall report for specific model numbers.  The lower seat anchors used to secure the child seat base may fail, allowing the child seat to detach.  As such, these child seats fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 213, "Child Restraint Systems."

title: Mack Trucks, Inc.: Steer Axle Fasteners Not Tightened Properly (17 affected)
summary: Mack Trucks, Inc. (Mack) is recalling certain 2023 Granite (GR) vehicles.  The front-drive steer axle fasteners may not have been tightened sufficiently and could come loose, resulting in a complete separation of the axle assembly joints.

title: Lordstown EV Corp: Electric Park Brake May Fail and Cause Rollaway (7 affected)
summary: Lordstown EV Corp (Lordstown) is recalling certain 2023 Endurance vehicles.  The electric park brake (EPB) caliper washers may prematurely wear, decreasing the clamping performance of the EPB.

title: Xos, Inc.: Driveshaft Separation (275 affected)
summary: Xos, Inc. (Xos) is recalling certain 2021 RM01, SA01, and 2021-2022 SV05 vehicles.  The bolts connecting the electronic parking brake rotor to the driveshaft may have been improperly tightened.

title: Triumph Motorcycles America, Ltd.: Brake Disc May Detach (988 affected)
summary: Triumph Motorcycles America, Ltd. (Triumph) is recalling certain 2023 Bonneville T120 and Bonneville T120 Black motorcycles.  The left-hand side (LHS) brake disc may be improperly secured and can detach.

title: Newell Coach Corp.: Brake Lights May Fail to Illuminate (28 affected)
summary: Newell Coach Corp. (Newell) is recalling certain 2023-2024 P50 motor coaches.  The brake lights may fail to illuminate unless the brake pedal is fully depressed.

title: SAF-Holland: Lower Control Arm May Fail (435 affected)
summary: SAF-Holland is recalling certain ADZ-123-9 Truck Suspensions, part number 33100396.  The rear suspension lower control arm may fail.

title: Terex Advance Mixer, Inc.: Steer Axle Fasteners Not Tightened Properly (20 affected)
summary: Terex Advance Mixer, Inc. (Terex) is recalling certain 2022 Front Discharge Mixer Commander vehicles.  The front-drive steer axle fasteners may not have been tightened sufficiently and could come loose, resulting in a complete separation of the axle assembly joints.

title: Kia America, Inc.: Side Curtain Air Bags May Not Deploy Properly (188,912 affected)
summary: Kia America, Inc. (Kia) is recalling certain 2021-2023 K5 vehicles.  The side curtain air bags may have been installed incorrectly, causing them not to deploy properly in the event of a crash.

title: Grand Design RV, LLC: Incorrect Tire Information on Label/FMVSS 110 (139 affected)
summary: Grand Design RV, LLC (Grand Design) is recalling certain 2023 Imagine AIM travel trailers.  The Federal Certification Label incorrectly states the tire size and inflation pressure requirement.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 110, "Tire Selection and Rims."

title: Terex Advance Mixer, Inc.: Steering Shaft May Separate from Steering Column (271 affected)
summary: Terex Advance Mixer, Inc. (Terex) is recalling certain 2022-2023 Front Discharge Mixer Commander and Charger vehicles.  Improper installation or tightening of the steering shaft may cause it to come loose from the steering column and result in a loss of steering control.

title: AROW Global Corp: Emergency Exit Window Latch May Fail/FMVSS 217 (1,500 affected)
summary: AROW Global Corp (AROW) is recalling certain MV204 and MV207 emergency exit windows.  Please see the recall report for a complete list of part numbers and window sizes.  During a crash, the emergency exit window latch may fail and allow the window to open.  As such, these windows fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 217, "Bus Emergency Exits and Window Retention and Release."

title: Bentley Motors, Inc.: Seat Air Bag May Tear/FMVSS 214 & 208 (1,610 affected)
summary: Bentley Motors, Inc. (Bentley) is recalling certain 2020-2021 Continental GTC vehicles.  Due to a sharp edge on the air bag deflector bracket, the seat air bags may tear during deployment.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard numbers 214, "Side Impact Protection," and 208, "Occupant Crash Protection."

title: International Motors, LLC: Driveshaft Separation (660 affected)
summary: Navistar, Inc. (Navistar) is recalling certain 2023 International HV and 2023-2024 International MV vehicles.  The rear axle spring wedge shim may have been incorrectly installed, which can cause U-joint failure and result in driveshaft separation.

title: International Motors, LLC: Battery Box May Detach (791 affected)
summary: Navistar, Inc. (Navistar) is recalling certain 2023 International HV and 2023-2024 International MV vehicles.  The assembly bolts used to attach the battery box to the mounting bracket may be loose or missing.

title: Ford Motor Company: Steering Wheel May Lock-Up While Driving (343 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2023 Bronco Wildtrak and 2022 Bronco Raptor vehicles.  Internal damage to the steering gear may require increased steering effort or cause the steering wheel to lock-up.

title: Evelands Inc: Damaged Cooktop Control Valves May Leak Gas (25 affected)
summary: Eveland's Inc. (Eveland's) is recalling certain 2022 Scamp Trailer 13ft travel trailers, equipped with certain 2-burner Cooktops.  The burner control valves may become damaged, causing a gas leak.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Hydraulic Control Unit Malfunction (330 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain Mopar Hydraulic Control Unit/Anti-lock Brake system modules (HCU) with part number 68085397AB.  When installed in a vehicle, the HCU Module may falsely read pressure in the primary circuit and illuminate the brake lights, as well as allow the vehicle to start and shift out of park without first applying the brake pedal.

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): Seat Belt Buckle May Not Latch (448,613 affected)
summary: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2017-2020 CR-V, 2018-2019 Accord and Accord Hybrid, 2018-2020 Odyssey, 2019 Insight, and 2019-2020 Acura RDX vehicles.  A manufacturing issue with the front seat belts may cause the seat belt buckle channel to interfere with the release button, preventing the seat belt buckle from latching.

title: Rivian Automotive, LLC: Side Curtain Air Bag Improperly Secured (30 affected)
summary: Rivian Automotive, LLC (Rivian) is recalling certain 2022-2023 R1S vehicles.  The fasteners that secure the right and left side curtain air bags may be improperly secured.

title: Gilbarco, Inc.: Cracked Capacitor May Cause Overheating (12,000 affected)
summary: Gilbarco, Inc. (Gilbarco) is recalling certain Orpak/Gasboy automatic tank gauge and environmental monitoring systems, model 800907451.  The capacitor may crack, causing overheating.

title: Ford Motor Company: Inoperative Trailer Taillights/FMVSS 108 (2,716 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2023 Maverick vehicles.  A missing electrical circuit may cause the trailer taillights to not illuminate as intended when utilizing the vehicle trailer tow electrical connector.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, " Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: Kibbi, LLC: Entry Door Latch Failure (63 affected)
summary: Kibbi, LLC (Kibbi) is recalling certain 2022-2023 Renegade RV Classic, Explorer, and XL Motorhomes.  The entry door latch may fail and not allow entry or exit.

summary: The drawcord on the hoodies has small plastic caps that can be swallowed by a nursing baby, posing a choking hazard. Units: About 7,500.

title: Bedshe International Recalls Bedsure Electric Heating Blankets and Pads Due to Fire and Thermal Burn Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The controller for the electric heating blankets and pads can malfunction, posing fire and thermal burn hazards. Units: About 350,000.

title: BeyondMedShop Recalls Vaunn Medical Adult Bed Rails Due to Serious Entrapment and Asphyxia Hazards
summary: When the recalled bed rails are attached to an adult's bed, users can become entrapped within the bed rail or between the bed rail and the side of the mattress. This poses a serious entrapment hazard and risk of death by asphyxiation. Units: About 102,000.

title: Crib Bumpers Recalled Due to Violation of Federal Crib Bumper Ban; Suffocation Hazard; Sold by Meiling Hou (Recall Alert)
summary: Infants can suffocate if they roll or move on the crib bumper in a position that obstructs breathing. Padded crib bumpers are banned under federal law. Units: About 125.

title: Epoch Everlasting Play Recalls All Calico Critters Animal Figures and Sets Sold with Bottle and Pacifier Accessories, More than 3.2 Million, Due to Choking Hazard; Two Deaths Reported
summary: The bottle and pacifier accessories pose a choking hazard to children. Units: More than 3.2 Million.

title: Fantasia Trading Recalls Anker Power Banks Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The lithium-ion batteries in the recalled power banks can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 42,000 (In addition, about 620 were sold in Canada).

title: Monoprice Recalls Pure Outdoor Cooking System Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The insulation coating on the stove can ignite during use, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 3,780.

title: Sandoz Recalls Aprepitant Capsules and Lidocaine and Prilocaine Cream Prescription Drugs Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Packaging Requirement; Risk of Poisoning
summary: The recalled prescription drugs and products that contain lidocaine must be in child resistant packaging as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act (PPPA). The packaging of the products is not child resistant, posing a risk of poisoning if the contents are swallowed by young children. Units:

title: Vornado Air Recalls Portable SRTH Small Room Tower Heaters Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The heaters have a miswiring due to a manufacturing error which can cause the tower heater to overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 1,450.

title: YETI Recalls 1.9 Million Soft Coolers and Gear Cases Due to Magnet Ingestion Hazard
summary: The magnet-lined closures can fail and result in detached magnets, posing a risk of serious injury or death if ingested. title: Active Sports Recalls Wakeboard Bindings Due to Fall Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: During use, the binding can partially detach from the binding baseplate at the heel or the external binding mount can crack and detach from the wakeboard, causing the user to lose their balance and fall into the water. Units: 850.

title: DR Power Equipment Recalls PRO XL501 Chipper Shredders Due to Laceration Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The fin scroll of the chipper shredder can fail, ejecting pieces of metal from the chipper shredder hopper during operation, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 2,100 (In addition, about 27 were sold in Canada and about 3 were sold in Mexico).

title: Helly Hansen Recalls Adult Workwear Sweatshirts and Hoodies Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard and Burn Hazard
summary: The recalled clothing fails to meet flammability standards for clothing textiles, posing a risk of burn injuries to consumers. Units: About 13,900 (In addition, 128,680 were sold in Canada).

title: Multi-Purpose Kids Bike Helmets Recalled Due to Risk of Head Injury; Sold Exclusively on Amazon.com; Sold by Ouwoer Direct (Recall Alert)
summary: The recalled helmets do not comply with the positional stability and impact attenuation requirements of the CPSC federal safety standard for bicycle helmets. The helmets can fail to protect a child in the event of a crash, posing a risk of head injury. Units: About 120.

title: Patagonia Recalls Patagonia Infant Capilene Midweight Base Layer Sets Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The snaps in the bodysuit of the recalled base layer sets can detach, posing a choking hazard if mouthed by infants. Units: About 8,000 (In addition, about 217 were sold in Canada).

title: Primark Recalls Children's Bamboo Plates Due to Risk of Lead and Chemical Exposure Hazards
summary: The recalled children's bamboo plates have elevated levels of lead and formaldehyde. Both lead and formaldehyde are toxic if ingested by children and can cause adverse health effects. Units: About 1,665.

title: Relion Battery Recalls Relion Insight Series Lithium Batteries Due to Thermal Burn and Fire Hazards
summary: The batteries can overheat, posing thermal burn and fire hazards. Units: About 7,250 (In addition, about 121 were sold in Canada).

title: Smocked Runway Recalls Classic Whimsy Children's Pajamas Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standards and Burn Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The recalled children's pajamas fail to meet the federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children. Units: About 7,200.

title: TJX Recalls Office Chairs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The back of the chair can break or detach from the seat base when a consumer is seated in the chair, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 81,700 (In addition, about 1,000 were sold in Canada).

title: Burnham Commercial Recalls Natural Gas Boilers Due to Burn Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: Delayed ignition and/or flame rollout can occur with the boilers, posing a burn hazard. Units: About 185.

title: Kawasaki Motors USA Recalls Engines Sold on Ferris and SCAG Riding Lawn Mowers Due to Burn and Fire Hazards
summary: The high-pressure fuel line can get damaged by contact with the fuel pump cover, causing a fuel leak that poses burn and fire hazards. Units: About 33,100.

title: Textron Specialized Vehicles Recalls Arctic Cat Alterra 600 and Tracker 600 All-Terrain Vehicles (ATVs) Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The ATV's A-arm can separate from the frame and cause loss of steering control, posing crash and injury hazards. Units: About 3,800 (In addition, about 1,200 were sold in Canada) (Arctic Cat and Tracker ATVs have been previously recalled in July 2022).

title: Mockingbird Expands Recall to Include Single Strollers Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The lower side of the stroller frame can crack, posing a fall risk to children in the stroller. Units: About 25,390 (149,000 Single-to-Double Strollers were previously recalled in November 2022).

title: Ecoxall Recalls Sodium Hydroxide Caustic Soda Beads and Potassium Hydroxide Flakes Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Packaging Requirements; Sold Exclusively on Amazon.com
summary: The products contain sodium hydroxide or potassium hydroxide which must be in child resistant packaging, as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act (PPPA). The packaging of the products is not child resistant, posing a risk of chemical burns and irritation to the skin and eyes. In addition,

title: Fredericksburg Farms Recalls 10 Ounce Scented Candles with Glass Lids Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: Some of the glass lids are too tight causing the jar to break when the lid is forcibly removed, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 6,500.

title: IKEA Recalls Mirrors Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The plastic fittings that attach the mirror to the wall can break, causing the mirror to fall, posing a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 22,400 (In addition, about 17,500 were sold in Canada).

title: Pfizer Recalls Nurtec ODT Prescription Drugs Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Packaging Requirement; Risk of Poisoning
summary: The recalled prescription drugs must be in child resistant packaging as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act (PPPA). The packaging of the products is not child resistant, posing a risk of poisoning if the contents are swallowed by young children. Units: About 4.2 million.

title: Polaris Recalls Sportsman All-Terrain Vehicles Due to Fire and Crash Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: An improperly assembled wiring harness can contact the brake line and/or vehicle frame during use which can result in a loss of the use of the front brakes and/or fire, posing fire and crash hazards. Units: About 80,000 (In addition, about 13,900 were sold in Canada).

title: STIHL Incorporated Recalls Docking Stations Sold with STIHL iMOW Robotic Lawn Mowers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The docking station's printed circuit board can short circuit when exposed to moisture, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 2,700.

title: Sunbeam Heated Blankets Recalled Due to Burn and Fire Hazards; Distributed by Star Elite
summary: The recalled heated blankets can overheat, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 43,000 (In addition, about 15,000 were sold in Canada).

title: The Laundress Recalls Fabric Conditioners Due to Chemical Hazard, Including Previously Recalled Units
summary: The fabric conditioners can contain a chemical impurity, ethylene oxide, a carcinogen that can cause adverse health effects if there is significant and direct long-term exposure. Units: About 800,000 (730,000 of the 800,000 were recalled on December 1, 2022). (An additional 13,000 units were sold in

title: Bicycles and Framesets Recalled Due to Crash Hazard; Manufactured by Open Cycle
summary: The rear brake can fail, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 270.

title: Cannondale Recalls Tesoro Neo X Speed Electric Bicycles Due to Fall and Injury Hazards
summary: The bicycles do not meet the U.S. safety standard; the hand brakes are configured in accordance with the European safety standard which is reversed from the U.S. safety standard, posing fall and injury hazards to the rider. Units: About 75.

title: Carhartt Recalls Men's Work Pants with Hem Adjustment Cords Due to Fall Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Dick's Sporting Goods
summary: An elastic drawstring hem near the ankle of the pants can create an extended loop, posing a trip and fall hazard. Units: About 32,505.

title: Delta Enterprise Corp. Recalls 2-in-1 Outdoor Kids Swings Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The swing seat restraint straps can break, posing a fall hazard to young children. Units: About 43,380.

title: Higdon Outdoors Recalls Battery Packs on XS Series Motion Waterfowl Decoys and Replacement Battery Packs Due to Fire and/or Burn Hazards
summary: The recalled waterfowl decoys' lithium-ion battery packs or replacement battery packs can overheat while charging or soon after charging, posing a fire and/or burn hazard. Units: About 45,000 (In addition, about 500 were sold in Canada).

title: JBM International Electric Recalls Adult Bike Helmets Due to Risk of Head Injury; Sold Exclusively on Amazon.com (Recall Alert)
summary: The recalled helmets do not comply with the positional stability and labeling and certification requirements of the U.S. CPSC federal safety standard for bicycle helmets. The helmets can fail to protect in the event of a crash, posing a risk of head injury. Units: About 5,300.

title: Jetson Electric Bikes Recalls 42-Volt Rogue Self-Balancing Scooters/Hoverboards Due to Fire Hazard; Two Deaths Reported
summary: The lithium-ion battery packs in the self-balancing scooters/hoverboards can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 53,000.

title: Lexmark Ventures Recalls Solexio Hair Stylers Due to Electrocution or Shock Hazard
summary: The cord on the hair stylers can detach if the unit is dropped, posing an electrocution or shock hazard to users. Units: About 26,830.

title: Polaris Recalls RZR Recreational Off-Road Vehicles Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The alternator can fail during operation, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 200 (In addition, about 2 were sold in Canada).

summary: S. 619 of the 118th Congress became Public Law 118-2 on 2023-03-20.

title: New law: Disapproving the action of the District of Columbia Council in approving the Revised Criminal Code Act of 2022. (Public Law 118-1)
summary: H.J.Res. 26 of the 118th Congress became Public Law 118-1 on 2023-03-20.
